propositions: Bare substring containment checks for upstream URL (pandoc.org or github.com/jgm/pandoc) in NOTICE accept lookalike hosts that do not actionably point to upstream (suffix: pandoc.org.evil.com, prefix: notpandoc.org).
The test assertion must reject suffix-style and prefix-style lookalike hostnames while accepting the real upstream URL and its variants (www subdomain, trailing slash, http/https).

Replacing substring `in` checks with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead boundaries (`(?![\w.-])` after pandoc.org, `(?![\w-])` after the github path) rejects both lookalike classes while preserving legitimate NOTICE content.
CodeQL alert #88 (py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization) must clear after the fix lands and code-scanning re-analyzes the default branch.
